text: My office has received a petition signed by representatives of 52 households, along with supporting documentation detailing a pattern of hazardous driving conditions. Residents are requesting urgent intervention to improve safety through the implementation of traffic calming measures, including speed humps, bollards, increased signage and signalization. St. Phillips Road is a residential street with a significant number of families and young children. Documented incidents, including repeated speeding and loss-of-control collisions, indicate a persistent safety risk. Notably, two separate collisions occurred on December 14, 2025, May 24, 2026 in which vehicles struck the same hydro pole in front of 47 St. Phillips Road. These incidents, occurring within a six-month period, resulted in substantial damage and neighbourhood-wide power outages, underscoring the recurring nature of the issue.…
